name: SDN Standards Discovery Flow
description: HTTP standards-discovery flow (gateway loop G.2): a $HTQ HttpRequest enters on the http-request trigger, foundation/http-route discover emits the routing decision (standards | not_found), hostcap/p2p-discovery standards issues the policy-mediated p2p.standards_snapshot hostcall (newest stored signed $PNM per (peer, standard), attribution from the record store's provenance) and re-emits the decision, foundation/discovery-shape standards splices the $PNM frames verbatim / encodes the bare-array json presentation and the shared FNV-1a etag, and foundation/http-respond assembles the final $HTR envelope (200/304/404) delivered to the host-model egress sink. Bridge linkage: the only host crossing is the declared p2p_read hostcall.

externalInterfaces.description: Policy-mediated read-only host discovery snapshots (peerstore + DHT + EPM registry + stored PNMs).

acceptedTypeSets.description: Canonical WASM-served HTTP request envelope ($HTQ, module-sdk schemas/HttpRequestAbi.fbs).

inputPorts.description: One HTTP request envelope as delivered verbatim by the host pipe.

acceptedTypeSets.description: Canonical WASM-served HTTP response envelope ($HTR, module-sdk schemas/HttpResponseAbi.fbs): STATUS, HEADERS (sorted, lower-cased names), BODY. The host streams it back verbatim.

outputPorts.description: Exactly one HTTP response envelope per invoke.
